hook: Telangana's Germany jobs plan: *12 of 79* trainees deployed, says TOMCOM
hook_b: Signed up for TOMCOM's Germany programme? Here's what the RTI shows
tldr: RTI replies to Siasat.com show TOMCOM counts 12 of 79 Ausbildung candidates as deployed to Germany.

beats.what: TOMCOM told Siasat.com, via RTI, that 12 of 79 apprenticeship candidates went to Germany.
beats.why: Candidates questioned the 2024–25 programmes run with private partner Fairstreet India.
beats.care: Weighing a state overseas-jobs scheme? Ask for batch-wise placement numbers first.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: 💼 Opportunity check. TOMCOM (Telangana Overseas Manpower Company) ran a German Ausbildung (apprenticeship) programme and a bus-driver programme. It counts 12 of 79 Ausbildung candidates, about 15%, as deployed. Its batch table lists 11, plus one Batch 3 candidate still awaiting a visa. Of the bus-driver trainees (19 per RTI, 24 per another reply), four got work contracts and two have pre-visa approval; none has gone yet. Candidates dispute the count. TOMCOM withheld its MoU with Fairstreet, citing confidentiality. Fairstreet says it fulfilled its obligations.

cards.q: Would you join a state overseas-jobs programme?
opts: Only with a job offer first

cards.q: How many TOMCOM bus-driver trainees have reached Germany?
cards.why: Four got work contracts and two have pre-visa approval, but none has gone yet.

insight: None of the bus-driver trainees has reached Germany yet, per TOMCOM's own replies.

learn.t: Ausbildung = Germany's paid vocational apprenticeship, mixing classroom and on-the-job training.

watch: Whether TOMCOM explains the 11-vs-12 gap and releases its MoU with Fairstreet.
